image_query: Kedarnath Temple Garhwal Himalayas stone shrine
tweets: Kedarnath — devoted to Śiva, this stone temple stands at 3,583 m in the Garhwal Himalayas, its walls of massive grey slabs fitted without mortar. Legend holds the Pāṇḍavas sought Śiva here after Kurukṣetra; the present shrine is believed to date to the 8th century CE.

In June 2013, flash floods tore through Kedarnath town — yet the temple stood almost untouched, a huge boulder lodging behind it and splitting the torrent around its walls. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history
